name: ClinicalTrials
description: ClinicalTrials.gov is the world's largest clinical trial registry, containing protocol and results data for federally and privately funded studies on human health interventions including drug trials worldwide.

name: OncoKB
description: OncoKB is a precision oncology knowledge base providing expert-curated evidence on the oncogenic significance of individual mutations and their therapeutic implications, with an FDA-recognized evidence level system.

name: TrialPanorama
aim: Clinical trial data for NLP/AI benchmarking
description: TrialPanorama is a comprehensive clinical trial dataset curated for AI/NLP research, providing structured trial metadata including eligibility criteria, interventions, outcomes, and results across global trial registries.

name: ChemProt
description: ChemProt is a BioCreative VI benchmark dataset for extraction of chemical-protein interactions from biomedical literature, providing annotated relations across 10 relation classes for NLP model evaluation.

name: BioRED
description: BioRED is a rich biomedical relation extraction dataset with annotations for multiple entity types (chemical, gene, disease, variant, species) and multiple relation types across full-text PubMed articles.

name: BC5CDR
description: The BC5CDR corpus provides manually annotated chemical and disease named entities and chemical-disease induced relations in PubMed abstracts, widely used for NER and relation extraction benchmarking.

name: CHEMDNER
description: The CHEMDNER corpus provides annotated chemical entity mentions in PubMed abstracts, created for the BioCreative IV CHEMDNER task to benchmark chemical named entity recognition systems.

name: PrimeKG
description: PrimeKG (Precision Medicine Knowledge Graph) is a multimodal knowledge graph designed for precision medicine, integrating disease biology, drug targets, and clinical outcomes from 20 curated databases to support therapeutic target identification.

name: Hetionet
aim: Biomedical heterogeneous network for drug repurposing
description: Hetionet is an integrative biomedical knowledge graph constructed from 29 databases with 11 types of entities including genes, compounds, diseases, pathways, and anatomies, widely used for drug repurposing and pathway analysis.

name: BioKG
source: Integrated from UniProt, STRING, SIDER, DrugBank, DisGeNET
description: BioKG is a large-scale, ready-to-use biomedical knowledge graph for link prediction and drug repurposing, integrating protein interactions, drug targets, disease associations, and side effects.

name: SPOKE
description: SPOKE (Scalable Precision Medicine Open Knowledge Engine) is a comprehensive biomedical knowledge graph developed at UCSF, integrating diverse biological data across multiple domains to support precision medicine applications.

name: MSI (Multiscale Interactome)
source: DrugBank, STRING, GO, Reactome, human interactome
description: The Multiscale Interactome (MSI) is a network integrating drug-protein and protein-protein interaction data across biological processes and pathways to explain drug mechanisms and predict drug repurposing.

name: ROBOKOP
aim: Automated biomedical reasoning and KG querying
source: Integrated from many NCATS Translator databases
description: ROBOKOP (Reasoning Over Biomedical Objects linked in Knowledge Oriented Pathways) is a biomedical knowledge graph system enabling automated question answering over large-scale integrated biomedical knowledge.

name: CTD (Comparative Toxicogenomics DB)
description: CTD (Comparative Toxicogenomics Database) manually curates chemical-gene, chemical-disease, and gene-disease relationships from scientific literature, elucidating molecular mechanisms underlying environmentally influenced diseases.

name: UMLS (Unified Medical Language System)
aim: Unified biomedical vocabulary and ontology integration
description: UMLS (Unified Medical Language System) is a compendium of many controlled vocabularies in the biomedical sciences providing a mapping structure for 200+ medical vocabularies and standards to facilitate NLP and interoperability.

name: SNOMED CT
aim: Clinical terminology for EHR and coding
description: SNOMED CT (Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine – Clinical Terms) is the most comprehensive clinical terminology system providing a consistent way to index, store, retrieve, and aggregate clinical data across specialties and sites of care.

name: MedDRA
aim: Regulatory medical terminology for adverse events
description: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities) is a standardized medical terminology used in regulatory submissions and pharmacovigilance, providing a hierarchical coding system for adverse events and medical conditions.

name: NCI-60
aim: Cancer cell line drug screening panel
description: NCI-60 is a panel of 60 human tumor cell lines used by the National Cancer Institute for large-scale drug screening, providing GI50, TGI, and LC50 data for hundreds of thousands of compounds across 9 cancer types.

name: CIViC
aim: Clinical variant evidence for cancer therapy
description: CIViC (Clinical Interpretation of Variants in Cancer) is an open-access, community-driven knowledgebase providing interpretations of cancer variant clinical significance and therapeutic implications for precision oncology.

name: PubTator3
aim: Automated biomedical entity annotation in literature
description: PubTator3 provides automatic annotations of biomedical entities (genes, chemicals, diseases, variants, species, cell lines) in PubMed and PMC using state-of-the-art NLP models, with relation extraction.

name: SemMedDB
source: SemRep NLP system applied to MEDLINE
description: SemMedDB contains semantic predications (subject-predicate-object triples) extracted from all MEDLINE citations using the SemRep NLP system, enabling large-scale biomedical knowledge discovery from literature.

name: EnzChemRED
description: EnzChemRED (Enzyme-Catalyzed Chemical Reaction Relation Extraction Dataset) provides annotated documents for the task of extracting enzyme-catalyzed chemical reactions, supporting biomedical NLP for biochemistry.

name: BioKDE
description: BioKDE (Biomedical Knowledge Discovery and Exploration) is a platform providing structured biomedical knowledge for exploring entity relationships across genes, diseases, drugs, and biological processes.

name: PLINDER
aim: Protein-ligand structure dataset for binding prediction
description: PLINDER is a comprehensive protein-ligand interaction dataset derived from the PDB, providing high-quality 3D structural data with rigorous train/test splits for benchmarking protein-ligand binding prediction models.

name: PDBbind
description: PDBbind is a comprehensive collection of biomolecular complexes from the PDB with experimentally measured binding affinity data, widely used as a benchmark for protein-ligand docking and affinity prediction.

name: GenomicKB
source: GENCODE, Ensembl, ENCODE, Roadmap Epigenomics, GTEx, GWAS Catalog, 4D Nucleome, RNAcentral (30+ consortia)
description: GenomicKB is a knowledge graph integrating data on the human genome, epigenome, transcriptome, and 4D nucleome from 30+ major consortia, with 347M genomic entities and 1.36B relations, enabling coding-free graph queries for genomic research.

name: NCI Thesaurus (NCIt)
description: The NCI Thesaurus (NCIt) is a reference terminology and biomedical ontology for cancer and related biomedical research, providing descriptions for >170,000 concepts including drugs, diseases, biological processes, and anatomy.

name: Cochrane Library
description: The Cochrane Library provides high-quality, independent evidence to inform healthcare decision-making, containing systematic reviews and meta-analyses of clinical trials including drug efficacy and safety assessments.

name: PharmVar
description: PharmVar (Pharmacogene Variation Consortium) is the central repository for pharmacogene variation, providing standardized allele nomenclature for clinically important pharmacogenes including CYP2D6, CYP2C19, and others.
